The [[Great Battle Field]] is a large area of plains sweeping to the north of the [[Temple of War]] in [[the Fissure of Woe]].  It is the site of the never-ending battle between [[Balthazar]]'s [[eternal army]] and [[Menzies]]' [[shadow army]]. The field contains two battle camps, one for each opposing army. There are many exits from the great battle field: north-east to the [[Burning Forest]], south to the Temple of War, south-west to the [[Tower of Courage (landmark)|Tower of Courage]], or north-west to the [[Forest of the Wailing Lord]]. 

The field is patrolled largely by the [[skeletal army]], an army comprised of the fallen soldiers of both the [[shadow army]] and the [[eternal army]].
